15:52.text: When they entered unto him, and said: Salâm
said: "Indeed! We are afraid of you."

15:53.text: said: "Do not be afraid! We give you glad tidings of a boy

15:54.text: said: "Do you give me glad tidings
when old age has overtaken me? Of what then is your news?"

15:55.text: said: "We give you glad tidings in truth. So be not of the despairing."

15:56.text: said: "And who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except those who are astray?"

15:57.text: said: "What then is the business on which you have come, O Messengers?"

15:58.text: said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn

15:59.text: . Them all we are surely going to save

15:60.text: "Except his wife, of whom We have decreed that she shall be of those who remain behind

15:61.text: came unto the family of Lût

15:62.text: He said: "Verily! You are people unknown to me."

15:63.text: They said: "Nay, we have come to you with that

15:64.text: "And we have brought you the truth
(the news of the destruction of your nation)
and certainly, we tell the truth.

15:65.text: "Then travel in a part of the night with your family, and you go behind them in the rear, and let no one amongst you look back, but go on to where you are ordered."

15:66.text: And We made known this decree to him, that the root of those
was to be cut off in the early morning.

15:67.text: And the inhabitants of the city came rejoicing
(at the news of the young men’s arrival)

15:68.text: said: "Verily! these are my guests, so shame me not.

15:69.text: "And fear Allâh and disgrace me not."
